_comment: Libraries compiled into Qt that expose no version at run time. Values come from Qt's qt_attribution.json files for the Qt release below. sbom_native.py fails the build when the bundled Qt version differs, so update this list with every PySide6 upgrade. 'license' is an SPDX expression; 'copyright' is the line THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt prints.
